To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
users' enjoyment and understanding levels depend on the cognitive style, the quality of the multimedia content, and the quality of service of the underlying network.

(i) the cognitive styles of users have significant effects on their levels of understanding and on their enjoyment of multimedia content, (ii) users' levels of enjoyment and understanding are significantly affected by the quality of service provided by the underlying network; (iii) the multimedia quality of the network significantly affects the levels of understanding of users with a Bimodal cognitive style, but has no significant effect on the levels of understanding or enjoyment of users with a Visual or Verbal cognitive style.

the multimedia quality of content delivered by a network is a key factor influencing users' quality of perceived multimedia, and that cognitive styles have a significant impact on the way in which multimedia content is perceived by users.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an understanding of the cognitive styles of Web users and their impact on their perception of multimedia quality.
the development of a cognitive model for user perception of multimedia, with a view to enhancing users' multimedia quality of experience.
the effects of multimedia quality on users' quality of experience, and the effect of users' cognitive styles on their quality of experience.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
multimedia quality of service is not a significant factor in users' perception of the quality of multimedia content.
the multimedia quality of experience (QoE) is a complex function of the multimedia quality of content (QoC), and the quality of service (QoS) provided by the underlying network.
the quality of multimedia content is a key determinant of users' perception of quality, regardless of their cognitive style.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
multimedia content is best suited to users with a visual preference, whilst the quality of multimedia delivery has a significant influence on all users.

the cognitive approach to user perceptions of multimedia quality is a promising area of research, and that further research should be conducted to examine the relationships among users' cognitive styles and the quality of service of the underlying network.
multimedia content should be presented with weak dynamism and without text to maximize users' levels of knowledge acquisition.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the quality of multimedia content should be tailored to users' cognitive styles in order to maximize the quality of users' perceptions of multimedia content.
the cognitive styles of users must be considered when designing personalized multimedia content for the Internet, as this can lead to a better user experience.
the design of personalized multimedia content must take into account the cognitive styles of the users.
